rationale: Recoverable or loggable checkpoint times enable the mapped partition-and-test procedure to run. Auditing their availability establishes access to observations without changing the mechanism, evidential warrant, or target. The mapping already permits missing checkpoints to yield a wider final interval.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Audit ticket histories for timestamp coverage at intermediate checkpoints, identify informal or unrecorded handoffs, and determine which missing times can be reconstructed or captured through temporary logging.
